steps.code:
# We have the downloaded song IDs. Now loop: go to next song, check if current song is downloaded.
downloaded_ids = {s['song_id'] for s in all_downloaded}
current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=login_result['access_token'])
print(f"Current song: {current['song_id']} - {current['title']} (downloaded: {current['song_id'] in downloaded_ids})")

# Keep going to next song until we find a downloaded one
while current['song_id'] not in downloaded_ids:
    next_result = apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=login_result['access_token'])
    print(f"Next song result: {next_result}")
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=login_result['access_token'])
    print(f"Now playing: {current['song_id']} - {current['title']} (downloaded: {current['song_id'] in downloaded_ids})")

print(f"Reached downloaded song: {current['title']} (ID: {current['song_id']})")
